'''Etti IV''' was a hot, stormy and dense [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Etti IV also had a population of the [[Etti]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who left the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] circa [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] to escape persecution.

The world was a crossroads for several major trading routes, and was hospitable to most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] races, making it a logical center for Authority .

The planet was the headquarters of [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. In [[321 BBY]], an embezzlement scandal resulted in twelve Cybot Galactica executives being imprisoned on the penal colony of [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]].

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], crime boss [[Ploovo Two-For-One/Legends|Ploovo Two-For-One]] was operating on Etti IV. An attempt by him to double-cross [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] resulted in a major panic throughout Mondder's spaceport district. Fortunately, Solo was able to escape with his ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]'','' held at the time in [[Docking Bay 45]].

The [[Rakririan]] [[Sabodor]] ran a famous pet shop, [[Sabodor's/Legends|Sabodor's]], on Etti IV, offering rare animals to the wealthy.

The planet was home to [[Deena Shan]].

A thief from Etti IV applied for transfer to [[Wraith Squadron]], but it was denied.
